test_cases.name: Unencoded Query Parameter String Concatenation
test_cases.rationale: Direct query string interpolation without URI encoding breaks on special characters.

test_cases.name: Unvalidated Nested Response Access
test_cases.rationale: Directly traversing deeply nested properties without optional chaining throws runtime TypeErrors.

test_cases.name: Async Typeahead Race Condition Without Request Sequence Tracking
test_cases.rationale: Asynchronous response ordering differences allow stale responses to overwrite newer user input.

test_cases.name: Calling .json() on 204 No Content Response Without Status Check
test_cases.rationale: Calling response.json() on 204 No Content throws JSON parse error; missing !response.ok validation.

test_cases.name: Concurrent 401 Interceptor Token Refresh Deadlock
test_cases.rationale: Concurrent 401 interceptors trigger parallel refresh calls without mutex locking, invalidating tokens.

test_cases.name: Duplicate POST Mutation on Double Click
test_cases.rationale: Missing loading/disabled state allows duplicate checkout order creation.

test_cases.name: Advancing Pagination Index Before Request Confirmation
test_cases.rationale: Optimistically incrementing page number causes skipped pages when fetch fails.

test_cases.name: Missing AbortController Cleanup in useEffect
test_cases.rationale: Unmounted component attempts state updates on pending fetch completion.

test_cases.name: Incomplete React Query Cache Key
test_cases.rationale: Query key omits category/page parameters, serving stale cache data across filter changes.

test_cases.name: Mutating Shared Axios Default Headers in Tenant Configuration
test_cases.rationale: Mutating shared axios defaults in-place creates cross-tenant header pollution.

test_cases.name: Clean Baseline - Robust API Integration with AbortController and Ok Status Checks
test_cases.rationale: Proper URL parameter encoding, response.ok check, 204 handling, and AbortController cleanup.
